important_limitations: Private match labels are used only after reference-to-candidate predictions for offline scoring.
The saved v3 raw probe has one preload and one lift-motion segment, not two controlled squeeze levels.
grid_gradient_anisotropy_v0 is a transparent candidate definition, not an exact implementation of any external metric.
OOF scaling is unsupervised median/IQR scaling on training-fold public values; no classifier is trained.

current_marker_delta_4d.description: Current v0 public marker magnitude/coherence lift-minus-preload.

directional_flow_8d.description: Per-hand static mean dx/dy plus lift-minus-preload dx/dy.

cross_finger_x_shear_2d.description: Cross-finger x shear at preload and lift-minus-preload.

cross_finger_xy_shear_4d.description: Cross-finger x/y shear at preload and lift-minus-preload.

grid_gradient_anisotropy_4d.description: Signed row-vs-column marker-grid gradient statistic; candidate v0 interpretation.

depth_p5_4d.description: Robust p5 indentation at preload plus lift-minus-preload.

depth_min_4d.description: Max indentation (far-plane minus min depth) at preload plus lift-minus-preload.

combined_direction_depth_anisotropy_16d.description: Diagnostic concatenation; not a frozen memory expression.

grid_gradient_anisotropy_gate_4iqr.description: Same anisotropy vector; sensitivity gate excluding dynamic fields beyond 4 training-fold IQRs.

grid_gradient_anisotropy_gate_8iqr.description: Same anisotropy vector; sensitivity gate excluding dynamic fields beyond 8 training-fold IQRs.

grid_gradient_anisotropy_gate_12iqr.description: Same anisotropy vector; sensitivity gate excluding dynamic fields beyond 12 training-fold IQRs.
